subject: general
question: Annamacharya composed Sankirtans in praise of which God?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Venkateshwara**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Annamacharya** composed Sankirtans primarily in praise of **Lord Venkateshwara**.
 
• Annamacharya, also known as **Tallapaka Annamacharya**, was a 15th-century Hindu saint and the earliest known Indian musician to compose songs called **Sankirtanas**.
 
• His compositions are considered to be among the finest in Telugu literature and are dedicated to the deity of **Tirumala Venkateswara Temple**.
 
• Annamacharya is regarded as the **pioneer of the Telugu keerthana** and a significant figure in the **Bhakti movement**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Annamacharya is believed to have composed over **32,000 Sankirtanas**, though only about 12,000 are available today.
 
• His works are preserved in the form of copper plates, which were hidden for centuries in a rock-built cell called the **Sankeertana Bhandaram** at the Tirumala temple.
 
• These compositions are sung even today in the **Tirumala temple** and other Venkateswara temples around the world.
 
• The themes of his songs often revolve around **devotion, morality, and the greatness of Lord Venkateshwara**.
